summary: Comprehensive test of Tony Yoga admin pop-up + App Store/Play link controls, PWA, Capacitor native override, and local /brand/seed image serving after VPS-hardening import. 13/13 backend pytest tests passed and 14/14 frontend flows passed. All requirements verified: admin can save/stop/customize the pop-up; App Store URL becomes a real <a> link on public homepage; Google Play link is real and points to com.tonyoga.app; validation rejects javascript:/wrong-host/http store URLs; PWA manifest+sw served; ?native=1 skips landing; mobile viewport has no overflow and bottom-nav present; /brand/seed/ images all load (naturalWidth>0). Settings restored to defaults (app_store_url='', popup_enabled=true, mode=app, delay=30) after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.py PUBLIC_FIELDS has 'social_whatsapp' listed twice (line 226 and 235) — harmless (set semantics for iteration keeps single entry) but should be de-duplicated for cleanliness.

google_play_url validation blocks port other than 443/None but rejects any URL containing user/pass — matches spec; consider allowing localized hosts (play.google.com/store already covers ?hl=en_IN via query, so fine).

AppDownloadsSettings.jsx: on save it only sends form KEYS subset — but the client sends the full form each time, which is fine (backend ignores unknown keys and preserves masked secrets). No fix needed.
Admin route uses single /admin page with ?tab= query param; document this pattern so future testers use /admin?tab=downloads directly.
test_credentials: Admin tony@tonyyoga.com / TonyYoga2026! ; Student student@demo.com / Student2026!
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded data). Temp changes to settings reverted to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin settings live at /admin?tab=downloads (single-page admin with ?tab= query param — do NOT try /admin/settings). Public pop-up settings served from GET /api/settings/public. Settings validation for app_store_url requires https://apps.apple.com/... (host, scheme, no port other than 443, no auth). PWA files at /manifest.json and /sw.js. ?native=1 in URL sets sessionStorage flag and skips marketing landing to /home (or /login if unauth). Local seed images live under /brand/seed/*.
